datasets.label: Typical home value
datasets.note: Zillow Home Value Index (ZHVI). Single-family homes and condos in the middle third of values, smoothed and seasonally adjusted.

datasets.label: Typical rent
datasets.note: Zillow Observed Rent Index (ZORI). Asking rents for all homes and apartments, smoothed.

datasets.label: Median list price
datasets.note: Median asking price of single-family homes and condos listed for sale, smoothed.

datasets.label: Median sale price
datasets.note: Median price single-family homes and condos sold for, smoothed.

datasets.label: Homes for sale
datasets.note: Number of single-family homes and condos listed for sale during the month, smoothed.

datasets.label: Median days to pending
datasets.note: Median days from listing to an accepted offer, smoothed.
